name: choose
description: Ask the person to pick one of the options. Show the question and each option as a choice; the person picks exactly one. Reply with the option picked, as given.

actions.description: Options that are actions beside the choices, not choices, e.g. Set up a new line

back.description: The option that is the way back, drawn apart from the others

options.description: The options; the answer must be one of them

primary.description: The option that is the primary action: the options are then the step's actions, this one first; none: the options are choices, sent with the submit button

submit.description: What the button sending the choice says, e.g. Next
